Version 3 is out ↗
Fast on web. Fast on native.
Now with style props or Tailwind.

Feels like web, runs like native, with zero-cost abstractions from compiler to runtime.

Typed inline styles, or Tailwind classes. Runtime, or build time. Add the Rust compiler or native runtime for best-in-class performance everywhere.

v3 trims down, then adds Tailwind, React Strict DOM, and simplified, more web-aligned styling.

wwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwww
Tamagui
Tailwind
import { html, styled } from 'tamagui'

<html.button
  px="4"
  py="2"
  rounded="4"
  bg="blue-9 hover:blue-10"
>
  <html.span color="white">Ship it</html.span>
</html.button>

// or lift it into a component
const Button = styled(html.button, {
  px: '4',
  py: '2',
  rounded: '4',
  bg: {
    default: 'blue-9',
    hover: 'blue-10',
  },
})
Featuring
A native runtime with no re-renders at all.
An optimizing compiler in Rust, flattening your tree.
A Rust syntax and theme LSP for every editor.
Bundler plugins for Vite, Next, Metro, and Webpack.
React Strict DOM primitives, real elements on the web.
Write Tailwind classes on the same compiler.
Level-based themes, nested as deep as you like.
Theme and media hooks with signal-like reads.
Animation drivers driven outside React.
A 0-runtime mode for plain CSS output.
Flat, typed style values with conditions inline.
Themes server rendered, with no flash.
